title: Sharplink call to action
description: A black band holding a slightly lifted panel inside a dotted frame with tiny blue squares at its corners: an outline mark top left, a two-tone statement (bright first line, faded second) whose letters assemble as you scroll, two square buttons at the bottom, and a tall outline drawing on the right that is uncovered top-down by the scroll, with a small blue target square at its centre.
notes: always dark: it carries the .dark class
the drawing is a slot (about 0.73 wide per tall, contained); empty, it shows a dotted outline frame
CSS view timelines only; without support or with reduced motion everything is in place
name: sharplink-cta

props.name: mark

props.name: primary
props.description: the main button (solid, with the sliding arrow)

props.name: secondary
props.description: the tinted button next to it

props.name: media
